name: retractable_stamp
description: Guided push-down stamp with a central shaft, telescoping skirt and functional steel helical return spring.
construction: Conforming six-material tetrahedral volume with flat spring-end lands bonded to the cap and sleeve seats. The shaft and guide have independent free surfaces.

metadata.spring_wire_profile: 1.2 mm high by 1.2 mm wide octagonal straight-sided wire
metadata.tilt_restraint: The concentric shaft/bore and skirt/shroud form two clearance guides. An ideal prismatic axis is assumed in the bench test.
metadata.part_3_change: Label 3 now contains a bonded steel spring. Remove old collar material overrides and collar-specific radial tests when integrating.

behavior_validation.scope: ideal axial guided, force-driven reduced-order FEM contact/release bench
